title: 3-Day Sahara Tour from Marrakech

itinerary: Leave early for the High Atlas and Aït Ben Haddou. Continue through the Ouarzazate region and the Valley of Roses. Settle into a valley guesthouse for the first night.
Walk a short stretch of Todra Gorge before continuing east. Reach Erg Chebbi for the evening, with time to enjoy the changing light and settle into camp.
An early start and the return across southern Morocco. This is the longest driving day; leave the evening free and avoid a same-day flight connection.
practical: The return is a long travel day, often around 9–10 hours on the road before longer stops. Timing varies with the route and conditions. Camp facilities and the transfer method must be confirmed.
